### What's new in v1.0.1
- **Sharper app icon.** It now comes in nine sizes from 16 to 256 px, with simpler versions for the smallest sizes, so it looks crisp in the taskbar, the system tray, the title bar and on high-DPI screens.

### Download
Download `Recur-v1.0.1-win-x64.zip`, unzip it, and run `Recur.exe`. You don't need to install anything, because .NET is built into the exe.

**Updating from v1.0.0:** close Recur (right-click the tray icon → Exit), then replace your old `Recur.exe` with the new one. Your habits stay where they are.

Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time, because the exe isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Your habits are stored in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\HabitApp\habits.db` and never leave your computer.
